test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 30 June, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Three Statements are given followed by Three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All beds are pillows.

No pillow is a chair.

Some tables are chairs.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some tables are pillows.

II. Some beds are tables.

III. No bed is a chair.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.
Both conclusions I and III follow.

solution:
Given Statements:

All beds are pillows.

No pillow is a chair.

Some tables are chairs.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://lh7-us.googleusercontent.com/HXBOJs0OJVra2-33ZVxB4myUO0ZPh5C2ZPAHL2K6hB9aAn-pBmuuVnaca8p9FRCsPnsLHwUnzXski9-VJr30rTcdetFPOiD-emWkbtTOg_dJ2a34Z_hpWEItK5UKhdtNlhzEIVmWdykrds683EEf9tA] 

Conclusions:

I. Some tables are pillows - False (Because, No definite relation given between table and pillows, so it can be possible only).

II. Some beds are tables - False (Because, No definite relation given between beds and tables, so it can be possible only).

III. No bed is a chair - **True **(Because, All beds are pillow and no pillow is chair, so no beds is chair definitely true).

So, Only conclusion III follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
